tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi mgon khang chen mo gsar bzhengs kyi rten rnams kyi gzungs gzhug bzhugs tshul gyi dkar chag mthong ba yid 'phrog ces bya ba bzhugs lags so/ /dge'o// shrī wan sang gu ru badz+ra ā tsar+ya gu tri ni ye na ma/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam chos skyong nor lha bcas pa la/ /gus pas 'dud do bdag cag dpon slob kyis/ /bsam pa mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ /'dir sgyur byed ces pa sa mo phag lo nyis thog bla brang gi shul du gtsug lag khang gsar du bzhengs pa'i mtshan mngon dga' bde ba can du gsol nas/ rten gyi gtso bo rje sa skya pa chen po'i sku dang / nged rang gi 'dra 'bag mchod dpon smon lam rin chen gyis bzhengs pa gnyis kyi gzungs gzhug bzhugs tshul thor bkod pa la/ gnyis char la stod smad bar gsum gyi gzungs sngags kyis tshan pa gsum byas pa re re/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel/ bla ma gong ma'i na bza' kun 'dus/ dbu lo kun 'dus/ gdung rus kun 'dus/ dam rdzas ril bu 'bum rdo/ khri rdo/ stong rdo/ brgya rdo sogs kyi thum che ba re re bzhugs shing / gzhan bla ma gong ma'i na bza' bub dang / dbu lo bub/ bris thang byin rlabs can sogs so sor mi 'dra ba bzhugs pa'i tshul/ rten gtso gur gyi mgon po'i sku la kye rdor lha dgu'i bris thang lam 'bras brgyud pa yongs rdzogs bcas pa sngags 'chang chen po dang rje grol mchog gi phyag nas ma yab rje nyid kyis gzhi bsnyen gnang dus kyi thugs dam rten 'khrul med/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi bris thang gong gi bla ma gnyis kyi phyag nas ma yab rje nyid kyi thugs dam rten/ sa lo'i thugs dam ma'i yang dag lha dgu'i bris thang che legs/ yang rje grol mchog zhabs kyi thugs dam ma'i bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i bris thang che legs 'dod lha mang pos bskor ba/

sngags 'chang chen po'i thugs dam ma'i rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dkar bdud phur srung bcu gnyis dang bcas pa'i bris thang che legs/ yang mgon po'i bla ma brgyud pa yongs rdzogs gur mgon lha brgyad/ dur khrod bdag po/ bran bdud/ ru 'dren/ bde kye/ gur drag dur khrod kyi bkod pa sogs zab rgyas yod pa'i bris thang che legs sngags 'chang chen po'i thugs dam ma/ yang dus mdos skabs sngags 'chang chen po'i thugs dam rten rgyun ring mdzad pa'i gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad/ bla ma yi dam sogs 'dod lhas bskor ba'i bris thang che legs/ yang grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i thugs dam ma bla ma gong ma so so'i chos skyong zhal gzigs kyi bkod pa dang bcas pa'i gur mgon gyi sku bcu dgu bla ma brgyud pa rags bsdus kyai rdor dang bcas pa'i bris thang me 'bar ma/ yang sa lo'i spur ras la grub pa'i gur gyi mgon po'i sku brgya dang bcu gsum/ bir+wa pa/ pu tra rnams kyi sku brnyan yod pa'i bris thang sngags 'chang chen po'i sku tshe gtan gang gi thugs dam ma/ yang sa lo'i phyag bris ma'i gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad/ ru 'dren sde bzhi/ 'byung 'dul/ bla ma brgyud pa rags rim dang bcas pa'i sku brnyan yod pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can/ yang chos rgyal 'phags pa'i thugs dam ma gur mgon lha brgyad/ 'byung 'dul/ rgyud mgon/ ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dur khrod kyi bkod pa rgyas pa/ bla ma brgyud pa 'phags pa yan chad dang bcas pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can/ yang byang sbug pa kun dga' legs rin gyi thugs dam ma gur mgon lha brgyad/ ru 'dren sde bzhi/ bla ma gong ma so so'i gur mgon gzigs snang gi bkod pa/ dur khrod kyi zhing bkod rgyas pa/ yi dam bde kye gsang gsum/ 'jigs byed/ dus 'khor/ gshed dmar/ phur pa/ rdo rje 'chang sogs yod pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can/ yang sa lo chen po khu dbon gyi sku tshe hril po'i thugs dam rten gtso bo gur mgon la las mkhan lnga/

ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dur khrod bdag po/ las mkhan mi nag sogs kyis bskor ba'i bris thang byin rlabs can/ de rnams la sa lo/ sngags 'chang / grub mchog bsod nams dbang po rnams kyi phyag bris gzungs rgyas pa phal cher la yod/ yang chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dngos slob cig gi thugs dam gur mgon lha brgyad/ 'byung 'dul/ rgyud mgon/ bde kye gnyis/ dur khrod kyi bkod pa rgyas pa/ gur mgon rigs lnga/ bla ma brgyud pa phal cher/ 'jigs byed chen po/ mahā kā la la gshin rje brgyad kyis bskor ba/ mahā de ba'i sras po drag po mu stegs brgyad kyis bskor ba/ mahā kā la chen po la lha chen brgyad kyis bskor ba/ chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing la snang srid brgyad kyis bskor ba/ chos 'khor yongs kyi srung ma la dam can brgyad kyis bskor ba/ dam tshig can gyi dgra lha la ru tra brgyad kyis bskor ba/ sgo ma bzhi/ klu sgrub dang / bram ze mchog sred/ a bha ya ka ra/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rnams kyi gur mgon gzigs snang la byung ba'i bkod pa sogs yod pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can/ yang sngags 'chang chen po'i sku srung gi sa lo chen po'i dbu lo bubs ma nyams pa/ sa lo'i phyag phreng / mgon po'i rang srung rgyas pa/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku srung la cher gtad sa los phyag bris gnang ba/ yang sngags 'chang chen po'i sku srung gi bye brag mang po sku dreg shin tu che ba dang bcas pa/ ba so'i mgul sho gsum brtsegs/ yang ba so'i mgul the/ sa lo chen po dang sngags 'chang chen pos dbang bskur gnang tshad kyi skabs kyi gos chen ser po'i snam sbyar bubs ma nyams pa/ sngags 'chang chen pos gsung ngag gnang dus kyi sku chos bubs ma nyams pa/ grub thob bsod nams dbang pos byas 'gyur du lo gsum gnang dus kyi sku gzan bubs ma nyams pa/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i sku chos bubs ma nyams pa/ rje mus chen gyi sku chos bubs ma nyams pa/

yang sa skya pa chen po'i sku rgyan rus rgyan yongs rdzogs bubs ma nyams pa sngon gyi kha yig 'byar ba/ yang sa lo chen po dang / sngags 'chang chen po/ yab rje bde gshegs gsum gyis gsung bsnyen mdzad tshad kyi bsnyen phreng khug ma dang bcas pa dri bsung khyad par can 'phro ba/ yang sa lo'i thugs dam ma'i lam 'bras brgyud pa nas bris thang lnga dang / bde mchog brgyud pa nas gsum sogs bzhugs shing / gzhan chos skyong gi sku thams cad la yang brgyud rim gnyis nas bris thang gsum dang re re thams cad la bzhugs shing / ༈ /yang dpal mgon bram gzugs kyi sku la/ rje btsun grags pa'i thugs dam ma'i zhal bzhi yongs rdzogs/ sgrub dus zhal khra can gtso bo zhal bzhi pa brtsegs zhal rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis dang / kye rdor/ gur mgon/ 'byung 'dul/ yum chen bzhi/ e ka dza ti/ lha mo 'dod khams ma dang dud gsol ma/ a tsa ra mang po/ jo mo zhwa thebs can/ dur khrod kyis bskor ba'i bkod pa sogs yod pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can/ yang sngags 'chang chen po'i dus mdos skabs kyi thugs dam rten rgyun ring mdzad pa'i gtso bo bram gzugs la yum chen bzhi/ bla ma gnyis dang bcas pas bskor ba'i bris thang byin rlabs can/ yang yab rje nyid la 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug gis gsol ba btab nas phyag bris gnang ba'i gtso bo zhal khra can la yum chen bzhis bskor ba'i bris thang byin rlabs can/ yang rje grol mchog zhabs kyi 'bral spangs kyi bram gzugs sngon po mi rkang 'bud pa la yum chen bzhis bskor ba'i bris thang / yang bla ma gong ma'i thugs dam ma'i zhal khra can yum chen bzhis bskor ba'i bris thang rnying ma byin rlabs can/ yang bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi thugs dam ma bsnyen dus kyi zhal bzhi pa yum chen bzhis bskor ba rgyab gzungs phyag ris ma shin tu rgyas pa yod pa'i byin rlabs can/ yang grub mchog bsod nams dbang pos thugs dam ma gtso bo sgrub dus kyi zhal bzhi bsnyen dus kyi zhal bzhi/

brtsegs zhal can rnams la yum chen bzhi bzhis bskor ba dang / ti se'i ri/ bsil ba'i tshal/ po ta la/ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod rnams kyi bkod pa dang / de rnams bram gzugs lnga lnga dang bcas pa dang / bla ma brgyud pa rags bsdus sbyin bdag dang bcas yod pa'i me 'bar ma/ yang bla ma gong ma'i thugs dam ma byin rlabs can bram gzugs kyi sku thang yum chen bzhi dang bcas pa'i bris thang / grub mchog bsod nams dbang po gsung bsnyen mdzad tshad kyi thugs dam bsnyen phreng bubs ma nyams pa sogs bzhugs shing / ༈ /lha mo'i sku brnyan la sa lo chen po'i sku tshe hril po'i thugs dam rten gtso bo 'dod khams ma lha mo rigs bzhi/ chu srin gdong can/ seng gdong can/ glang dang kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i gdong can/ dur khrod kyi bkod pas bskor zhing / e ka dza ti/ bram ze mchog sred dang bcas pa yod pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can/ yang gtso bo lha mo dud sol ma 'khor bzhon pa can bco lngas bskor ba'i rngog pa gdung brgyud rim pa bzhin gyi thugs dam ma bris thang byin rlabs can/ yang grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i thugs dam ma'i gras gtso bo 'dod khams ma la lha mo rigs bzhi/ 'khor gdong brnyan rnams dang / dur khrod bdag po/ dkar bdud/ dmag zor ma rnams kyis bskor zhing steng na bla ma brgyud pa rags bsdus/ e ka dza ti rnams yod pa'i bris thang me 'bar ma byin rlabs can/ yang gtso bo lha mo dud gsol ma 'khor lha mo rigs bzhi/ gza' ra hu la/ rnam sras sogs kyis bskor ba'i steng phyogs na kye rdor dpa' gcig rngog ston rin chen dpal bzang sogs kyi sku brnyan yod pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can/ yang 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' sangs rgyas kyi spur ras las bzhengs pa'i gur mgon lcam dral/ bram gzugs/ pu tra/ kye rdor/ phur pa/ bdag chen rang gi sku sogs yod pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can/ yang sa lo'i thugs dam ma'i kye rdor dpa' gcig sogs bzhugs shing /

༈ /pu tra chen po'i sku brnyan la/ 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug gis gsol ba btab nas yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos phyag bris gnang ba'i pu tra dngos dang 'dra ba'i bris thang byin rlabs can/ sa lo chen po'i dbu zhwa paṇa zhwa sku dreg can bubs ma nyams pa/ sngags 'chang chen po'i gsol phod rdo rje gsang lam ma rdor gong dang bcas pa bubs ma nyams pa dri bsung khyad par can 'phro ba/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi thugs dam ma gur mgon lha brgyad/ bla ma brgyud pa yongs rdzogs/ ru 'dren sde bzhi/ ber nag zangs gri can/ bram gzugs/ 'byung 'dul/ kye rdor sogs kyi bkod pa yod pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can/ yang grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i thugs dam gyi rten me 'bar ma'i gras gtso bo pu tra la/ gnod sbyin yab yum/ bha ṭa/ sring mo/ phyi nang gi las mkhan gnyis/ gaṇ+ḍe las sprul gyi pho nya'i tshogs/ bran bdud yab yum/ rdo rje phur pa/ bla ma brgyud pa rags bsdus/ sbyin bdag dang bcas pa'i bkod pa yod pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can sogs bzhugs shing / ༈ /gnod sbyin yab kyi sku la gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam ma mgon po lha brgyad/ bla ma brgyud pa gnyis/ kye rdor dpa' gcig dang bcas pa yod pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can/ ༈ /gnod sbyin yum gyi sku la bla ma gong ma'i thugs dam ma mgon po lha brgyad/ ru 'dren sde bzhi/ bram gzugs/ rgyud mgon/ 'byung 'dul/ bla ma brgyud pa yongs rdzogs dang bcas pa'i bris thang rnying ma byin rlabs can/ ༈ /bha ṭa'i sku dang sring mo'i sku la/ gur mgon lha brgyad/ bla ma brgyud pa rags rim dang bcas pa yod pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can re re sogs bzhugs shing / ༈ /dur khrod bdag po'i sku la yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i phyag bris ma shog thang byin rlabs can sogs bzhugs shing / sku thams cad la khyab par bzhugs pa'i sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs dam ma'i lam 'bras brgyud pa dang bde mchog brgyud pa gnyis gnyis kyi bris thang re re la gtso bo dang lha phran gyi bkod pa ji ltar bzhugs pa'i tshul mdo tsam brjod pa ni thog mar sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam 'bras brgyud pa'i bris thang gi gtso 'khor gyi lha grangs bzhugs tshul thor bkod pa la/

gtso thang la gtso bo rdo rje 'chang / lha phran/ sam+ba ra ya dang / bi shwa mā tre/ ༈ /bris thang g.yas dang po la/ gtso bo bdag med ma/ lha phran sa ra ha/ gur mgon bzhengs sku/ ༈ /g.yas gnyis pa'i gtso bo nag po pa/ lha phran ras chung lugs kyi tshe dpag med dang / shrī dza lan+dha ra/ ༈ /g.yas gsum pa'i gtso bo la/ a wa dh+wa dhi pa/ lha phran 'chi ba med pa'i lha mo zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug ma sku mdog dkar mo/ phyag mtshan g.yas par/ rdo rje/ zhags pa/ ral gri/ lcags kyu/ 'khor lo/ mda'/ gri gug tho ba/ g.yon par/ dril bu/ mdung / ka pā li/ bum pa/ gzhu/ kha ṭ+waṃ ka rnal 'byor pa thugs kyi rdo rje dang / gnyis spangs pa chen po/ ༈ /g.yas bzhi pa'i gtso bo/ 'brog mi/ lha phran/ sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo/ g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon me tog pad+ma'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ grub chen sha ba ri/ ༈ /g.yas lnga pa'i gtso bo/ zhang dgon pa ba/ lha phran/ jo bo rje lugs kyi gser mdog can gyi sgrol ma/ phyag g.yas bum pa/ g.yon pad+ma'i yu ba 'dzin pa/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ ༈ /g.yas drug pa'i gtso bo/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ lha phran/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ ༈ /g.yas bdun pa'i gtso bo/ rje bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ lha phran/ lo ki shwa ra/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng / ༈ /g.yas brgyad par gtso bo zhang dkon mchog pa/ lha phran tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma/ rnal 'byor pa sid+dhi pa la g.yas ḍā ma ru dang / g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa yum gyis 'khyud cing seṅge la chibs pa/ ༈ /g.yas dgu pa'i gtso bo bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ lha phran bkra shis sbyin pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad/ phyag mtshan/ ral gri/ rdo rje/ lcags kyu/ rtse gsum/ nor bu/ dbyug pa/ lcags kyu/ bum pa rnams bsnams pa/ 'phags pa lha/ ༈ /g.yas bcu pa'i gtso bo grub chen bud+dha shrī/

lha phran/ bla ma rin 'byung / yan lag med pa'i rdo rje la phyag mtshan rdor dril zhabs g.yon pas kha ṭ+waṃ ka bzung ba/ yum gyi g.yas pas ka pa li/ ༈ /g.yas bcu gcig pa'i gtso bo sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ lha phran mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can gyi mchod rten/ glu len la ba pa nyal stabs tshul/ ༈ /g.yas bcu gnyis pa'i gtso bo/ ngor chen dkon mchog 'phel ba/ lha phran/ badz+ra a yu ṣe dang / jo bo rje/ ༈ /bris thang g.yon gyi dang po'i gtso bo rnal 'byor dbang phyug lha phran sangs rgyas spyan ma/ ༈ /g.yon gnyis pa'i gtso bo ḍā ma ru pa/ lha phran sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i tshe dpag med sku mdog dkar po dkyil krung / phyag mtshan rdo dril/ slob dpon kā la ka la glang po che la chibs pa/ g.yas gri gug dang kha ṭ+waṃ ka bsnams pa yum gyis 'khyud pa/ ༈ /g.yon gsum pa'i gtso bo ga ya dha ra rat+na shrī/ lha phran sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po/ phyag g.yas bum pa thugs khar 'dzin cing g.yon mnyam gzhag rgyal po dpa' bo rdo rje g.yas rdo rje gtsug tu 'dzin cing / g.yon dril bu dkur 'dzin pa yum dang bcas/ ༈ /g.yon bzhi pa'i gtso bo se ston kun rig lha phran/ gser mdog can gyi sgrol ma zhal gcig phyag bcu pa/ phyag mtshan phreng ba/ dbyug pa/ ral gri/ rdo rje/ mda'/ ras dkar/ gzhu/ dril bu/ pad+ma/ zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka stag la chibs pa/ g.yas zhags pa dang / g.yon thod pa bsnams pas yum la 'khyud pa/ ༈ /g.yon lnga pa'i gtso bo sa chen/ lha phran mdo lugs kyi tshe dpag med bzhengs sku phyag gnyis kyis lhung bzed bsnams pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ༈ /g.yon drug pa'i gtso bo rje grags rgyal/ lha phran bde ba can gyi tshe dpag med dang / li hi pa/ ༈ /g.yon bdun pa'i gtso bo/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ lha phran/ dpa' bo grub pa nas gsungs pa'i rma bya chen mo sku mdog sngon po skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

g.yas rma bya'i sgro dang g.yon gyis bum pa/ ༈ /g.yon brgyad pa'i gtso bo brag phug pa/ lha phran dze ta ri lugs kyi tshe dpag med dang / mtsho skyes rdo rje/ ༈ /g.yon dgu pa'i gtso bo bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ lha phran/ thub pa mi ru si ka phyag g.yas shing 'bras/ g.yon mnyam gzhag ku ku ri pa/ ༈ /g.yon bcu pa'i gtso bo rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ lha phran/ rnam rgyal mchod rten dang / rdo rje 'chang gi gzigs snang ma'i bram gzugs/ phyag g.yas rkang gling dang / g.yon pa thod pa dang kha ṭ+waṃ ka bsnams shing / glang po che la po ti mang po'i khur bskur ba/ ༈ /g.yon bcu gcig pa'i gtso bo chos rje kun dbang pa/ lha phran/ slob dpon pad+ma/ mahā kā la sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gri gug dang rtse gsum g.yon gyis thod pa dang zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ ༈ /g.yon bcu gnyis pa'i gtso bo/ gur gyi mgon po bzhengs sku/ lha phran/ gur lha brgyad kyis bskor ba ste sku thang nyi shu rtsa lnga po 'di la gong bshams gos dkar/ zhal khebs sman rtse dang byang dar gyis byas pa'i byin rlabs che zhing spus legs gra mtshungs la bsdams thag byang dar ljang khu gnyis re yod pa rnams bzhugs shing / de yan gyi lam 'bras brgyud pa'i bris thang gi gtso 'khor rnams kyi bzhugs tshul bshad par bya ste/ de yang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i bde mchog brgyud pa'i bris thang gi gtso bo dang 'khor gyi lha grangs bzhugs tshul thor bkod pa la/ thog ma gtso thang gi gtso bo la rgyud gsung ba po'i rdo rje sems dpa' zhal drug phyag drug pa sku mdog dkar po phyag mtshan g.yas ral gri/ lcags kyu/ rdo rje/ g.yon gyis glegs bam/ pad+ma/ dril bu 'dzin pa/ lha phran rdo rje chos/ in+d+ra bo dhi/ bir+wa pa/ phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po pus btsugs thal sbyar gyis rdo rje 'dzin pa/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston/ ༈ /bris thang g.yas dang po'i gtso bo la sa ra ha dang /

klu sgrub/ lha phran/ shākya thub pa/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkhan po bo d+dhi satwa/ ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka dpal 'dzin rnams/ ༈ /g.yas gnyis pa'i gtso bo sha ba ri dang / lū hi pa/ lha phran/ dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum sku mdog ser mo phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ shan ta bha dra dam tshig rdo rje phyag gnyis kyis glang lpags kyi g.yang gzhi 'dzin pa/ bi ra ḍi/ phyag gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse sbyar ba gan rkyal du spyi bor 'dzin pa/ bram bhi ra ma ti phyag g.yas rdo rje bsnun cing / g.yon pas dril bu nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums kyis kha ṭ+waṃ ka 'dzin pa/ ༈ /g.yas gsum pa'i gtso bo dha ri ka dang / rdo rje dril bu pa/ lha phran/ bde mchog dril bu pa sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pas glang chen gyi ko ba'i g.yang gzhi 'dzin/ g.yas gzhan rnams la phyag mtshan rtse gsum/ gri gug lcags kyu/ ḍā ma ru/ g.yon pas mi mgo zhags pa/ kha ṭ+waṃ kha rnams 'dzin pa/ rdo rje gdan pa chen po/ dze ta ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ niska laṅka/ ra wi na tra rnams/ ༈ /g.yas bzhi pa'i gtso bo rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan dha ri pa/ lha phran/ gsung kye rdo rje zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog sngon po/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pas rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yum sku mdog sngon po/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/ nag lo/ gu lu pa rnams/ ༈ /g.yas lnga pa'i gtso bo la nag po spyod pa dang / gu h+ya pa/ lha phran/ rtsa rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum phyag gnyis pa g.yas kha ṭ+waṃ ka blar 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/

yum sku mdog dmar mo g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ glo bo lo tsā ba/ lo mchog rnams/ ༈ /g.yas drug pa'i gtso bo rnam rgyal zhabs dang / a dharba/ lha phran sdom pa 'byung ba sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pas glang lpags kyi g.yang gzhi 'dzin pa/ gsum pas ḍā ma ru dang / g.yon gsum pas thod pa dang kha ṭ+waṃ ka 'dzin pa/ a mo gha badz+ra phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ shākya seṅge dang / bya rder ba rnams/ ༈ /g.yas bdun pa'i gtso bo ti lo pa dang / nā ro pa/ lha phran mahā ma ya sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum phyag bzhi/ g.yas gnyis kyis mda' dang kha ṭ+waṃ ka g.yon gnyis kyis gzhu dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yum sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang po gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud cing / gnyis pas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ pad+ma rdo rje g.yas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ ye shes 'byung gnas/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ dbang phyug dpal/ ༈ /g.yas brgyad pa'i gtso bo dus 'khor ba chen po/ 'jigs med grags/ lha phran/ bde mchog sbyangs pa'i yon tan sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bcu gnyis pa/ dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pas glang chen gyi lpags pa'i g.yang gzhi 'dzin pa/ g.yas gzhan so sos/ lcags kyu/ rtse gsum/ 'khor lo/ ḍā ma ru/ g.yon pas/ ka pā li/ kha ṭ+waṃ ka zhags pa/ thod rlon rnams 'dzin pa/ yum sku mdog dmar mo phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ ra rdo rje grags/ di paṃ ka ra/ ra ye shes seṅge / ra chos rab rnams/ ༈ /g.yon dang po'i gtso bo/ klog skya shes rab rtsegs dang / mal lo/ lha phran bde mchog nag po lugs sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis/ dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pas glang lpags kyi g.yang gzhi 'dzin pa/

g.yas gzhan rnams rim bzhin/ ḍā ma ru/ dgra sta/ gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon pas/ ka pā li/ kha ṭ+waṃ ka zhags pa thod rlon rnams 'dzin pa/ yum sku mdog dmar mo g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ 'jam dbyangs g.yas pad+ma dang / g.yon chos 'chad/ ba liṃ ta pa/ 'bum seng / 'khon klu dbang bsrung ba/ dbang phyug grags rnams/ ༈ /g.yon gnyis pa'i gtso bo la rje sa chen dang / bsod rtse/ lha phran/ bde mchog lū hi lugs sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pas glang lpags kyi g.yang gzhi 'dzin pa/ g.yas gsum pas rim bzhin/ dgra sta/ gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon pas ka pa li/ zhags pa/ thod rlon/ yum sku mdog dmar mo gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ shes rab dpal/ blo gros brtan pa/ kun dga' brtson 'grus/ ༈ /g.yon gsum pa'i gtso bo/ rje grags rgyal dang / bdag nyid chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ lha phran/ bcom ldan 'das zhal gnyis ma'i gcig phag zhal sku mdog dmar mo zhabs g.yas bskums/ g.yon brkyangs/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon ka pā li dang kha ṭ+waṃ ka 'dzin pa/ dpal sde/ dri med sbas pa/ lo chen rin bzang / rin chen seṅge / nag tsho lo tsā ba rnams/ ༈ /g.yon bzhi pa'i gtso bo/ chos rgyal 'phags pa dang zhang dkon mchog pa/ lha phran/ mkha' spyod ma/ rin chen seṅge / rat+na kirti/ blo ldan shes rab/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ paṇa chen shākya shrī bha dra/ ༈ /g.yon lnga pa'i gtso bo/ na bza' brag phug pa dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ lha phran/ mai tri mkha' spyod/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ bla chen 'brog mi/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ rje 'gos rnams/ ༈ /g.yon drug pa'i gtso bo/ dpal ldan tshul khrims dang / ye shes rgyal mtshan/ lha phran/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ gnam kha'u pa/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/

'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bla chen dkon mchog blo gros/ rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan rnams/ ༈ /g.yon bdun pa'i gtso bo/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po dang / paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ lha phran/ rnam rgyal/ chos rgyal lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan/ bal bza' khri btsun/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po/ rgyal pa dbang phyug mnga' bdag khri ral/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ thun mi sam+bho ṭa/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od rnams/ ༈ /g.yon brgyad pa'i gtso bo glo bo mkhan chen pa dang / rje sangs rin/ lha phran/ sgrol dkar/ lha btsun byang chub grags/ mi nyag grags rdor rnams bzhugs pa'i si thang bcu drug dang / ras thang gcig ste bcu bdun yod pa'i gtso thang gi gong bshams byus sngon po spus legs/ g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis la bsham gos dmar mthong gos ser gyis byas pa/ gzhan ma sku thang bcu gcig po tshang ma'i gong bshams gos ljang skya/ thams cad la zhal khebs sman rtse dang byang dar sngon po byas pa'i spus legs gra mtshungs su yod do/ /de ltar gdan sa dpal ldan sa skya yi/ /bzhi thog bla brang mgon khang chen mo na/ /bzhugs pa'i rten gyi gzungs gzhug dkar chag 'di/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /sgyur byed ces pa sa mo phag lo yi/ /zla ba bzhi pa'i dmar cha'i tshes bzang la/ /bzhi thog bla brang 'od gsal snang ba ru/ /sbyar 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge gyur cig /legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba yis/ /bdag cag dpon slob yid la re ba'i don/ /ma lus mthar phyin phyi ma lhan cig par/ /dag pa'i zhing skyes don gnyis lhun grub shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ shrī badz+ra mahā ka la hūm̐ phaṭ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ bzhi thog bla brang gi mgon khang gi rten rnams kyi gzungs gzhug bzhugs tshul gyi dkar chag PAGE
